title: Hey I really hate to have to do this but I’m at a bit of a loss for what else to do… if we have any neurologists, psychiatrists, or really anyone who is familiar with medication interactions and/or neurological issues please dm me.
content: My mom is very sick and none of her doctors seem to have a clue what to do when we can even get them on the phone, which is rarely. The leading theory is currently that she must be having some sort of reaction to one of her meds, or that it’s a combination of several of them causing this. The problem is she has like 15 prescriptions from four different doctors and none of them can agree on anything other than that it’s probably some sort of reaction but they all just pass her on to the next one. I won’t give to much of her personal medical information out in public like this but if you have any sort of experience with this stuff please reach out.
